title: Broccoli in Cheese Sauce
subtitle: Tender broccoli florets baked in a sharp cheddar bechamel
excerpt: This is cauliflower cheese made with broccoli: florets in a well-seasoned cheddar sauce, bubbled until golden under a crust of more cheese. It works as a side or as a vegetarian main with bread.
sourceNotes: Cauliflower cheese is a British classic, documented in recipe books since the 19th century. This version substitutes broccoli, which handles the cheese sauce equally well.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the sauce and blanch the broccoli up to a day ahead. Assemble cold and bake straight from the fridge, adding 5 minutes.

content.text: Slightly undercook the broccoli when blanching. It will cook again in the oven and if it is already fully tender it will turn mushy.

items.prepNote: coarsely grated: 100g for the sauce, 50g for the top

content.text: Preheat the oven. Blanch the broccoli in a large pan of boiling salted water for 3 minutes. It should be just tender at the stalk but still bright green. Drain and set aside.
Make the sauce: melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the flour and stir constantly for 2 minutes.
Add the milk in a slow, steady stream, whisking constantly. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and smooth.
Remove from the heat. Stir in 100g of the cheddar, the mustard, and the nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the broccoli in a baking dish. Pour the cheese sauce over the top, making sure all the florets are covered.
Scatter the remaining 50g of cheddar over the top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

items.symptom: The sauce has split and looks oily.
items.cause: The heat was too high when the cheese was added.
items.fix: Always remove the pan from the heat before stirring in the cheese.

items.symptom: The broccoli is very soft and falling apart.
items.cause: It was blanched too long before baking.
items.fix: Blanch for 2 minutes maximum; it continues to cook in the oven.

items.cause: The dish needs more direct heat.
items.fix: Switch to the grill for 3 to 4 minutes at the end.
